kingdomsIntro: The world is divided into four kingdoms, one in each corner. Each has its own culture, its own allies, and its own story to tell.

features.title: Kingdoms RPG
features.body: Pick a side, grow your kingdom, and shape the story of the world alongside other players.

features.title: Races & Dungeons
features.body: Choose a race, explore an evolving world, and take on dungeons.

features.title: Friendly Community
features.body: An active Discord and a welcoming staff team. New players are always encouraged to jump in.

features.title: Java & Bedrock
features.body: Play on PC, console, or mobile. Everyone is welcome, whatever they play on.
